title: IT Services - Worldwide
highlights: Revenue in the IT Services market is projected to reach US$1.55tn in 2026.
IT Outsourcing dominates the market with a projected market volume of US$618.36bn in 2026.
Revenue is expected to show an annual growth rate (CAGR 2026-2031) of 4.61%, resulting in a market volume of US$1.94tn by 2031.
The average Spend per Employee in the IT Services market is projected to reach US$419.17 in 2026.
In global comparison, most revenue will be generated United States (US$575.01bn in 2026).
